text:
Marta Chen: Quick sync — I'm opening a small migration PR to refresh the SparkStart quickstart for SDK v6. Found a handful of auth/snippet nits and an outdated env var name. Planning: update TS + Py snippets, add a tiny migration table, and tweak CI so examples build in dist. Aim to keep it minimal so it ships fast.
Ashwin Rao: SGTM. Can you also swap the constructor example to the new Client(...) form in all TS/JS snippets? I noticed two places still using the old factory.
Marta Chen: Yup, will replace both. Also thinking to consolidate the auth examples into one collapsible section (sync vs async) rather than duplicate code. @Samira PTAL on env var change.
Samira Patel: Use `RW_API_KEY` as the canonical env var now. Legacy `REDWOOD_API_KEY` still works for a transition window but call out deprecation so users migrate. :+1:
Kai Nguyen: Heads up — add a short note about recommended token rotation and link to KMS guide. We should not make the quickstart security heavy, just a pointer. I'll paste the KMS doc link in a sec.
Kai Nguyen: KMS link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/kms-integration (placeholder)
docs-bot: created PR #4213 from mchen/sparkstart-sdk6-migration
Marta Chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4213 — contains snippet edits, an added migration table, and updated CI step in .github/workflows/examples.yml
Ashwin Rao: Quick CI note: change the examples CI step to run `npm run build && node dist/index.js` rather than `node src/index.js`. Our build step now compiles to dist and some samples import compiled outputs.
Marta Chen: Good catch — I'll change that. Also adding a tiny test that runs the example with a fake key env and asserts process exit 0, just to catch obvious regressions.
Samira Patel: Small copy nit: wrap env var names in backticks and avoid full sentences for one-liners. Keep examples under 80-100 chars per line for readability.
Marta Chen: Will format accordingly. Proposed migration table (short):

```
old -> new
REDWOOD_API_KEY -> RW_API_KEY
newClient(...) -> new Client({...})
```

Marta Chen: I'm also updating the Quickstart's TL;DR to mention local dev auth flow (env var) and point to the Console for onboarding.
Kai Nguyen: LGTM. If possible, add a one-liner about on-prem/private deployments not using Console tokens and link to the private deployment auth section.
Marta Chen: Noted, will add a parenthetical and link.
Samira Patel: I'll draft the release-note 2-liner once PR is open — can post in #announcements after merge.
Ashwin Rao: Will review PR tonight. If tests pass, we can merge by Friday EOD. Ping eng-oncall if CI flakes.
Marta Chen: Thanks all. I'll mark this as ready for review and add reviewers. If anyone wants to take the release-note or follow-up examples cleanup, shout here.
deploy-bot: example deployment check queued for PR #4213
Marta Chen: (added) small follow-up: can someone sanity-check the Python async snippet? I rewrote the aio usage to match the new client API.
Samira Patel: I'll eyeball the Py async snippet tomorrow morning.
Kai Nguyen: LGTM pending CI. :rocket:
